result:
Round 194 is a **FAIL**, even though all 13 of A's planned fixes are correct. Everything below was measured in a real browser (Playwright Chromium, fresh anonymous contexts, mock API on :5199), so `browserVerified=true`.

The failure comes from the task's own rule that any store text field I reach below 3:1 fails the round. One such field was outside A's list.

**Bugs for B:**
- **C-R194-01 (Medium):** the guest chat form on `/support` (name and email fields) has a border at **1.21:1** at all three viewports. At HEAD `caa09af` it was 1.62:1, so round 193 made it worse and round 194 didn't cover it.
  - Source: `GuestForm.tsx:67` and `:91`, which were not in the granted files.
  - Suggested fix: the same `border-outline-strong` swap. The `/hire-us` fields measure 3.70 with it.
  - This is the "A stops at K0 → B re-grants" path. A reported it; I reproduced it on my own.
- **C-R194-02 (Medium, test only):** the new ST8b guard misses a field whose class sits 14 lines below its tag, which is GuestForm's layout. My extra mutant m14 stays green, and so does the real tree with GuestForm still faint.
  - Cause: B's 14-line window spec and the off-by-one in `fieldscan.mjs`. A built it as specified and A's code reviewer flagged it.

**Rows that passed:**
- **Placeholder:** 5.10:1 at 1440, 1280 and 375 (was 3.41 in the round-193 tree). Typed text is 21:1, and the placeholder wording is identical to HEAD.
- **Granted field borders:** the lowest of the four edge midpoints (top, right, bottom, left) per field:

  | Field | 1440 / 1280 / 375 |
  |---|---|
  | F1 (newsletter) | 3.13 / 3.13 / 3.12 |
  | F2 (`/store` search) | 3.64 at all three |
  | F3–F6 (`/hire-us`) | 3.70 at all three |
  | F7, F8, F14 sign-in modal | 3.50, 3.30, 3.50 (1440 only) |

  Before this round these sites were 1.02–1.21. Keyboard focus still shows the brass border. The fallback colour for F1 was not needed.
- **Store pages:** across five store pages at three viewports, no layout box moved more than 1 px, no text contrast got worse, and the keep-list items (popup texts, CONTINUE, Free Samples, Limited, `/about` stats) are identical to HEAD.
- **Studio:** `/studio-lab` shows 0 changed pixels at 1440 and 1280 against the round-191 baseline, with 0 errors.
- **Premium access not bypassed:** `/studio-lab` opens as the demo with no account and 0 cookies. `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required". The studio-token endpoint returns 401 with no token and 403 with a fake one.
- **Scope:** the frozen file list is unchanged at start and end, and git status has exactly the expected 21 entries. Each changed site swaps one token, with no reformatting.
- **Test checks:** I re-ran the token tests on the tree and on scratch copies. They pass on the tree, fail on the start copies, and A's four mutants each fail as specified.

**Blocked (no backend in the cloud):**
- the `/account` password fields (F11–F13);
- the chat input (F16), because `/api/chat` needs sign-in in the mock;
- four fields in `recordings/` with the same faint border, which B still has to classify.

The `/cart` fields and the shared `Textarea` don't render on any page I could reach, so they are covered only by the unit tests. Full test suite, build and verify are left to the gate.

Under the task's plan, round 195 should be one more small fix (GuestForm plus a stronger ST8b) before the regression round. STORE-2a is not done, and rounds 193 and 194 stay unpublished.

I changed no app source. I stopped only the servers I started: the mock (7731), the round-193 reference (7835) and the HEAD copy (11276). The shared :5173 server was not touched.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- c-round-194.md
- c-round-194.json
- c-round-194/
